layers.inference: A defensible conclusion drawn FROM observed facts (e.g. a recommended unlock method, or the decision a metric would inform). Labeled as interpretation, never as a measurement.
layers.hypothesis: A plausible but unverified explanation that requires further evidence before action. Never presented as fact.
